run_compute_fid: run compute_fid to calculate the Frechet Inception Distance between real and generated image distributions
test_compute_fid: test compute_fid with a dataset of real images and a GAN generator to validate FID scores
review_compute_fid: review compute_fid to understand how Inception v3 features and covariance matrices are used for FID calculation
summarize_compute_fid: summarize compute_fid which computes FID using mean and covariance of Inception features from real and generated images
refactor_compute_fid: refactor compute_fid to support alternative feature extractors beyond the Inception v3 TorchScript model
